headline: NEW -- Ansar Allah ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh intercepted early Saturday
dek: Coalition air defenses 'intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the terrorist Ansar Allah militia toward Riyadh'; earlier a drone was 'intercepted and destroyed in the Eastern Province'. Saudi civil defense activated the National Early Warning Platform for Riyadh, Najran and Wadi…
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesman Brig. Gen. Turki Al-Malki (X post); Saudi Directorate of Civil Defence (early-warning alerts)
fault_line: Shield or exposure? Audiences argue whether intercepts prove Saudi air defenses work, or prove the capital is now permanently within Ansar Allah range.

sections.what_happened: Coalition air defenses 'intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the terrorist Ansar Allah militia toward Riyadh'; earlier a drone was 'intercepted and destroyed in the Eastern Province'. Saudi civil defense activated the National Early Warning Platform for Riyadh, Najran and Wadi al-Dawasir, then said 'the danger has passed'. An AFP journalist in Riyadh heard two explosions.
sections.what_verified: Intercept is the coalition's own primary claim; explosions heard are corroborated on the ground by an AFP journalist; civil-defense alerts reported across families.
sections.what_disputed: Ansar Allah have not claimed (or disclaimed) this specific launch at last check; interception success cannot be independently verified; Saudi civil defense warned that filming/publishing impact-site information 'exposes you to legal liability', suppressing independent damage reporting.
sections.why_matters: A ballistic missile over the Saudi capital while Trump promises 'another little Epic Fury' -- the war is now in Riyadh's sky, not just its waters.
sections.context: Background: NEW (in-window) -- Ansar Allah ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh intercepted early Saturday; explosions heard in the capital; civil-defense early-warning alerts in Riyadh, Najran, Wadi al-Dawasir; separate drone downed in Eastern Province

totw_analysis: Our read: A ballistic missile over the Saudi capital while Trump promises 'another little Epic Fury' -- the war is now in Riyadh's sky, not just its waters. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Shield or exposure? Audiences argue whether intercepts prove Saudi air defenses work, or prove the capital is now permanently within Ansar Allah range.
